title: Common Architecture Language Model Controls
description: Controls model requirements for domains. For example, a security domain contains a series of control requirements

controls.description: The controls that apply to an architecture element, each under a key of letters, digits and hyphens.

additionalProperties.description: One control in a controls map, with the requirements that define it.

description.description: A description of a control and how it applies to a given architecture

requirements.description: The requirements this control applies, each with its configuration.

control-detail.description: A control requirement this control applies, with its configuration given by address or inline, but not both.

requirement-url.description: The requirement schema that specifies how a control should be defined

config-url.description: The configuration of how the control requirement schema is met

config.description: Inline configuration of how the control requirement schema is met
